name: farma-jyv-pos
description: FarmaJyV Venta — punto de venta de escritorio (Angular + Electron)
author: FarmaJyV

scripts.test:electron: npm run prisma:generate && vitest run --config electron/vitest.config.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test -- --watch=false && npm run test:electron
scripts.electron:build: npm run prisma:generate && ng build --configuration electron
scripts.electron:build:dev-cloud: npm run prisma:generate && ng build --configuration electron-dev-cloud
scripts.electron:start: npm run electron:build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron electron/main.js
scripts.electron:dev: npm run prisma:generate && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:4400 FARMAJYV_ENV=emulator electron electron/main.js --dev
scripts.electron:dev:cloud: npm run prisma:generate && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:4400 FARMAJYV_ENV=dev electron electron/main.js --dev
scripts.electron:dist:dev:mac: npm run electron:build:dev-cloud && electron-builder --mac -c.appId=mx.farmajyv.pos.dev -c.productName="FarmaJyV Venta DEV" -c.directories.output=release-dev -c.publish.url=https://farma-jyv-dev-updates.web.app -c.extraMetadata.farmajyvEnv=dev
scripts.electron:dist:dev:win: npm run electron:build:dev-cloud && electron-builder --win -c.appId=mx.farmajyv.pos.dev -c.productName="FarmaJyV Venta DEV" -c.directories.output=release-dev -c.publish.url=https://farma-jyv-dev-updates.web.app -c.extraMetadata.farmajyvEnv=dev
scripts.release:mac: npm run electron:dist:mac && npm run release:prepare && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.release:win: npm run electron:dist:win && npm run release:prepare && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.release:dev:mac: npm run electron:dist:dev:mac && npm run release:prepare:dev && npm run deploy:dev
scripts.release:dev:win: npm run electron:dist:dev:win && npm run release:prepare:dev && npm run deploy:dev
